vacancies.title: Satcom Evaluation Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESTEC engineering role newly visible on SSC's official careers list; relevant as ESA exposure but specialized in satcom rather than mechanical/hardware engineering.

vacancies.title: PA and Safety Support Engineer
vacancies.assessment: PA/Safety exposure is relevant, but extensive space PA/QA experience required.

vacancies.title: Ground Segment Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESTEC role following satellite communications ground-segment R&D, industry proposals, technical reviews and development. Strong ESA exposure but requires substantial specialised satcom/ground-segment experience, making it a stretch for a mechanical engineering profile.

vacancies.title: Micro-Electronics Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Newly discovered direct ESTEC contractor role. Requires electronics/physics MSc and 5+ years across DSP, ASIC/FPGA design and verification, HDL tools and lab characterisation. Work supports ESA digital microelectronics R&D, qualification and verification. Valuable ESTEC placement but very limited match to mechanical/thermal/optomechanical background; specialist stretch. Official SSC deadline 15 Nov 2026.

vacancies.title: Mechanical Design & Structural Analysis Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Excellent direct ESTEC engineering match: MSc mechanical, 4+ years relevant experience, MGSE design, CAD, drawings, FEA, proof-load and acceptance tests. Industrial machine design and mechanical analysis highly relevant; 3DEXPERIENCE and Nastran/Patran are tool gaps.

vacancies.title: Test Facility & Instrumentation Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESA/ESTEC test-facility engineering role. Facility upgrades, technical procurement, installation, factory acceptance testing and support to test campaigns including TVAC align strongly with industrial machine development, technical supplier coordination and commissioning. MSc and approximately four years relevant engineering experience; direct space-test heritage is the main gap. Vacancy was identified in prior official SSC sweep and independently appears on SSC company jobs listings.
